lines.ref:
17
“Mum, there's a bad feeling
in my stomach that
won't go away”
what does it feel like?

17
“the feeling before something
bad is about to happen”

18
“Mum, I panicked in my exam
and completely failed”
“I'm sorry”

“what if I panic in everything
and fail at life?”

18
“Mum, I feel butterflies in
my stomach everyday”
“I think I need help”

20
realises her anxiety ultimately
stemmed from fear of rejection..
and being conditionally loved..

22
graduates

realises anxiety never stopped
her from “performing”

23
starts accepting it as part of
her life

24
“Mum, I think I'm getting better!”

“the butterflies don't bother me
as much anymore”

25
“realises she's developed high-
functioning anxiety”

which only stays silent when
she's “achieving”

28
still learning not to tie her self-
worth to her achievements

and seek self love from
within
if you were conditionally loved...

self love is a journey that's
rarely linear..
welcome to my journey 🫶

audit.notes: This format relies on authentic chronological personal history assets: childhood photos, high school photos, graduation portraits, and an emotionally vulnerable crying clip. Generic lifestyle b-roll cannot replace the specific past milestones that make this emotional storytelling work.
audit.summary: A chronological personal narrative tracking the creator's journey with anxiety and self-worth from age 17 to 28, moving from teenage photos to adult lifestyle b-roll set to Kanye West's 'Runaway'.
